issue.title: Doc-phrase terminology audits exceed the flake baseline from dirty-tree full-lane failures with no owner

task_type_fields.evidence:
Proposed by phase sase-1ou.1 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP note #3, class (d)) and filed by the sase-1ou land agent on 2026-10-28.

The two doc-phrase audit tests below exceed `tests/reproducible_flake_baseline.txt` in `.venv/bin/python tools/selection_health --fail-on-new-flake`. No open bead owns them, and phase 1 found no fixing commit. Both pass focused at sase master 86c3250e69 (2026-10-28, 41-node exceedance batch, 42 passed at -n 8). Every gate-countable record is a dirty-tree full-lane run. 96.5% of all 743 records in the window are dirty, so being dirty alone does not show WIP breakage.

- `tests/test_agent_session_terminology.py::test_current_docs_skills_and_memory_avoid_stale_family_phrases`: 5 gate-countable failure records (0 on clean trees), 2026-10-04 .. 2026-10-21; last record `20261021T043227Z-7a08bf2fda1a-2462853-full-run.json`
- `tests/test_sase_turn_terminology.py::test_current_docs_skills_and_memory_avoid_stale_shell_phrases`: 2 gate-countable failure records (0 on clean trees), 2026-10-16 .. 2026-10-23; last record `20261023T134315Z-92d271364cb5-3408687-full-run.json`

Next step: decide per node whether these are load flakes (the audit scans files that a concurrent test may be mutating) or WIP breakage from agents editing docs, skills or memory in a dirty tree. If they are WIP breakage, the gate's source-audit dirty-tree exclusion may need to cover these audits too. Either fix the cause, or close the bead when the records age out of the 30-day window with no recurrence. The land agent added both nodes to the baseline under this bead.

issue.creation_reason: Phase sase-1ou.1 left these two exceedances without an owner as class (d), and the flake-baseline gate requires a filed bead for every exceedance.
